title.ko: 기술 이야기: 현재완료 · 수동태 · 장점과 단점
title.en: talking about technology: present perfect, passive, advantages and disadvantages

explain.ko: 기술에 대해 이야기할 때는 현재완료로 변화를 말하고(Smartphones have changed our lives), 수동태로 일반적인 사실을 말합니다(This app can be downloaded for free). 장점과 단점은 On the one hand ..., on the other hand ... 또는 The advantage of ... is that ... / The disadvantage is that ...으로 대비해서 말합니다. 걱정은 I'm worried about ...으로, 이유는 because / so로 연결합니다.
explain.en: Use the present perfect for changes (Smartphones have changed our lives) and the passive for general facts (This app can be downloaded for free). Contrast advantages and disadvantages with On the one hand ..., on the other hand ... or The advantage of ... is that ... / The disadvantage is that ... Express worry with I'm worried about ... and link reasons with because / so.

task.model: Online shopping is very convenient because it saves time. On the other hand, personal data can be hacked, so I'm worried. This app can be downloaded for free, but you should be careful about security. Smartphone addiction is also a serious problem.

model_trans.ko: 온라인 쇼핑은 매우 편리해서 시간을 아낄 수 있어요. 한편으로는 개인 정보가 해킹당할 수 있어서 걱정돼요. 이 앱은 무료로 다운로드할 수 있지만 보안에 주의해야 해요. 스마트폰 중독도 심각한 문제예요.
model_trans.en: Online shopping is very convenient because it saves time. On the other hand, personal data can be hacked, so I'm worried. This app can be downloaded for free, but you should be careful about security. Smartphone addiction is also a serious problem.
